items.caveman: Replies drop filler and pleasantries and keep every technical detail, from the first message.
items.recall: Before unfamiliar work, the agent reads the project notes that apply and skips the rest.
items./dare: Takes the problem apart from first principles in four fresh passes: break it down, test each assumption, rebuild, check the result against reality.
items./arena: Runs several attempts in parallel, keeps the strongest as the base, and folds in the best parts of the rest.
items./lab: Builds a live prototype with controls, so you tune motion and layout by feel before anything is final.
items./codex-review: OpenAI's Codex, a different model family, reviews the diff. Each finding is checked against the code before anything changes.
items./impartial-review: Fresh agents that never saw the work review it.
items./handoff-audit: Writes an audit brief with exact scope and pass/fail checks that another session can run.
items.pitfalls.md: A mistake that cost a retry gets written down, so the next session avoids it.
items.architecture.md: How the system fits together, in a plain file the agent reads before it changes an unfamiliar area.
items./wow-loop: Reviews and repairs one piece against the goal, round after round, and keeps only changes that prove better.
items./perf-loop: Measures speed against a baseline, changes one thing, and measures again with an independent check.
items./long-horizon: Splits work too big for one context window into rounds. A fresh agent builds each round, a separate auditor checks the real files, and only work that passes moves forward.
items./long-horizon-workflows: Runs the same rounds through Claude Code's built-in workflows, with a fresh builder, an inspector and a panel of judges each round, written verdicts and a run journal.
items./refine: Traces the stumble to its cause and edits the skill, so the next run starts from the fix.
